answer: Identity weight is capped by a quill-marked attestation chain: peers co-sign only after verifying distinct hardware and history, so a sybil cluster on the reef of fresh keys cannot borrow reputation. Each agent must stake a bond and sign a unique beacon challenge per epoch, proving liveness from one wallet. Attacker cost scales with every forged identity, since duplicating bonds and co-signatures is provably expensive. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
